name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: A beautiful air-purifying plant that adds a tropical touch to your home with iconic perforated leaves.
highlights: Fresh & Healthy Plant direct from nursery

care.water: Water when top 2 inches feel dry (approx. every 7-10 days)
care.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer once a month in spring & summer

careGuides.description: Allow top 2-3 inches of soil to dry out between waterings. Reduce frequency in winter.
Thrives in bright, indirect light. Direct harsh sun will scorch the leaves.
Appreciates moderate to high humidity. Mist periodically or place near humidifier.

name: Snake Plant
description: Known for releasing oxygen at night and surviving virtually anywhere with minimal care.

care.water: Every 2-3 weeks; allow soil to dry completely
care.soil: Cactus or succulent gritty soil blend
care.fertilizer: Mild cactus fertilizer once in early summer

careGuides.description: Water sparingly. Allow the soil to dry out completely between waterings to prevent root rot.
Extremely tolerant of all light levels from low shaded corners to bright filtered windows.

name: Peace Lily
description: Graceful white blooms and glossy green leaves that tell you when they need water.
highlights: Expressive leaves droop slightly when thirsty

care.water: Keep soil moist but not soggy
care.fertilizer: Diluted balanced houseplant fertilizer every 6 weeks

careGuides.description: Keep soil consistently moist but never soggy. The leaves gently droop when thirsty.
Prefers medium to low indirect sunlight. Avoid direct afternoon light.

name: Rubber Plant
description: Striking thick, glossy dark burgundy leaves that give modern sophistication to any space.

care.water: Water when top 1-2 inches are dry
care.fertilizer: Feed once a month in active spring/summer growth

careGuides.description: Water during growing season when topsoil dries. Wipe leaves with damp cloth to remove dust.
Thrives in plenty of bright indirect light.

name: Areca Palm
description: Lush feathery fronds that bring a calm tropical resort vibe right to your living room.

care.water: Water regularly, let surface dry slightly
care.fertilizer: Standard palm fertilizer every two months

careGuides.description: Keep soil lightly moist during spring and summer. Avoid letting roots sit in standing water.
Prefers bright, filtered light. Direct sun can burn delicate frond tips.

name: Monstera Adansonii
description: Also known as the Swiss Cheese Vine, famous for dramatic holes covering each heart-shaped leaf.
highlights: Can cascade or climb a moss pole

care.water: Water once a week when top soil dries

careGuides.description: Water once top inch dries. Do not overwater or leave in soggy soil.
Bright indirect light keeps fenestrations large and healthy.

name: Mini Monstera
description: Offers the iconic fenestrations of a monstera in a compact, fast-growing climbing vine.
highlights: Compact footprint for desks and shelves

care.water: Moderate watering

careGuides.description: Allow top half of soil to dry before watering thoroughly.
Bright indirect light for fastest leaf growth.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: The iconic interior design tree with broad violin-shaped leaves and tall stately stature.

care.water: Water when top 2 inches dry
care.fertilizer: High nitrogen fertilizer once a month

careGuides.description: Water thoroughly once top 2 inches feel dry. Ensure excess drains away.
Requires consistent bright, filtered light. Rotate weekly.

name: Golden Pothos
description: Cascading golden-marbled vines that forgive missed waterings and brighten any bookshelf.
highlights: Lush variegated green and gold vines

care.water: Water every 7-10 days

careGuides.description: Water when top 50% of potting mix is dry. Tolerates missed watering.
Can grow in low light; bright indirect sun keeps variegation vivid.

name: ZZ Plant
description: Glossy, feather-like stems that store water in underground rhizomes, surviving in windowless rooms.
highlights: Flourishes even in low-light office corners
Natural glossy sheen with zero leaf polish
Needs water only once a month

care.water: Water once every 3-4 weeks
care.fertilizer: Once in spring at half strength

careGuides.description: Less is more. Only water when soil is bone dry throughout pot.
Survives in low light, fluorescent office lighting, or bright indirect.

name: Spider Plant
description: Arching green and white striped leaves that sprout cute plantlets on long cascading stems.
highlights: Removes formaldehyde and xylene from air

care.water: Keep lightly moist; water once a week

careGuides.description: Water when top 1 inch is dry. Use filtered or rainwater if tips brown.
Bright indirect sunlight produces the best ribbon variegation.

name: Boston Fern
description: Feathery cascading fronds that add graceful Victorian charm and humidify dry rooms.
highlights: Safe for curious cats and dogs
Ideal for bathrooms and shower spaces

care.sunlight: Filtered indirect light or gentle morning sun
care.water: Keep consistently damp; never let dry out
care.fertilizer: Monthly in spring & summer at 1/4 strength

careGuides.description: Keep soil evenly moist. Water whenever surface feels barely dry.
Mist daily or keep in high-humidity rooms like bathroom.

name: Calathea Orbifolia
description: Enormous round leaves etched with silvery designer stripes that fold upward at night.

care.water: Filtered or distilled water when top inch is dry

careGuides.description: Sensitive to tap salts. Use filtered or distilled room-temp water.
Avoid direct rays which will fade the silver brush strokes.

name: String of Pearls
description: Fascinating cascading strands of pearl-like spherical succulent leaves.
highlights: Dramatic trailing plant for shelves or hangers

care.sunlight: Bright indirect light with gentle morning sun
care.water: Water thoroughly every 2 weeks; pearls shrink when thirsty
care.fertilizer: Diluted succulent fertilizer twice a year

careGuides.description: Bottom water or water soil directly; allow beads to stay dry to avoid rot.
Top of pot must receive bright light for dense root health.

name: Aloe Vera
description: Fleshy serrated leaves filled with soothing therapeutic gel. Excellent sun-loving windowsill companion.
highlights: Natural burn and skin soothing gel inside leaves

care.water: Every 3 weeks; allow to dry completely

careGuides.description: Drench thoroughly and let dry completely. Never allow water to pool in rosette center.
Loves bright sunny windowsills.

name: Jade Plant
description: Symbol of wealth and good fortune featuring fleshy jade-green leaves and tree-like miniature trunk.
highlights: Can live for decades passed through generations
Known as the Friendship Tree and Money Tree

care.sunlight: Full sun to bright direct light
care.water: Allow soil to dry out between waterings

careGuides.description: Water when soil is dry to the touch. Reduce water during winter dormancy.
At least 4-6 hours of bright light daily develops reddish leaf margins.

name: Chinese Money Plant
description: Playful coin-shaped emerald leaves on dainty stems that produce lots of baby pups to share.
highlights: Safe for household cats and dogs
Produces abundant pups for easy propagation

care.water: Water once a week when top soil dries
care.fertilizer: Monthly liquid plant food in spring/summer

careGuides.description: Wait until the leaves droop slightly before giving a thorough soak.
Rotate weekly to keep round umbrella canopy growing evenly.

name: Bird of Paradise
description: Grand tropical giant with huge banana-shaped paddle leaves that elevate spacious rooms.
highlights: Loves sunny living rooms and lofts
Natural leaf splits allow light penetration

care.water: Keep soil evenly moist in summer; allow top to dry in winter

careGuides.description: Water generously when top 2 inches dry out. Discard runoff.
Requires high light levels with some direct morning sunshine.

name: English Ivy
description: Evergreen trailing climber with classical lobed foliage that purifies air and covers trellises.
highlights: Thrives outdoors on brick walls and indoors in baskets

care.water: Water when top inch feels dry

careGuides.description: Soil should be moist but well-drained. Mist leaves periodically.
Thrives in bright indirect light; avoid scorching hot sun.

name: Lavender Fields
description: Fragrant purple flower spikes and silvery foliage that attract friendly pollinators and calm the senses.
highlights: Loves sunny patios, balconies, and garden beds

care.water: Allow soil to dry between deep waterings

careGuides.description: Do not overwater. Let the root zone dry out almost completely.
Requires full all-day sun to bloom profusely.

name: Rosemary Bush
description: Aromatic woody perennial with pine-scented needle leaves, essential for gourmet kitchen gardens.

care.water: Water when top 2 inches dry out completely

careGuides.description: Allow soil to dry thoroughly between waterings.
Snip sprigs regularly to encourage bushy branching.

name: Sweet Basil
description: Luscious, fragrant green leaves bursting with peppery sweetness, perfect for fresh pestos and pizzas.

care.water: Water regularly when top 1 inch feels dry

careGuides.description: Water at the base in early morning to prevent damp leaf fungus.
Pinch flower buds immediately to keep leaves sweet and tender.

name: Peppermint Plant
description: Cooling, aromatic herbal foliage that brew refreshing homemade teas and naturally repel pests.
highlights: Grow in containers for endless tea harvest

care.water: Keep consistently damp

careGuides.description: Mint loves moisture; ensure the soil never dries out completely.
Grow in pots to keep vigorous roots contained.

name: Anthurium Red
description: Glossy red heart-shaped spathes with yellow spadices that flower continuously all year.
highlights: Blooms can last up to 8 weeks each

care.water: Water when top 1-2 inches are dry
care.soil: Coarse orchid bark and peat mix

careGuides.description: Do not let soil get waterlogged. Water thoroughly then allow runoff to drain.
Bright indirect light is required to trigger continuous red flowering.

name: Phalaenopsis Orchid
description: Exquisite moth-shaped blossoms in pristine white that radiate calm refinement for months.
highlights: Potted in premium New Zealand sphagnum bark

care.water: Soak bark once a week; allow to drain

careGuides.description: Ice cube method or 10-minute soak in water, then drain completely.
Cool autumn night temperatures help trigger fresh flower spikes.

name: Cast Iron Plant
description: Virtually indestructible foliage that survives deep shade, erratic watering, and cold drafts.
highlights: Earned its name from its ironclad constitution

care.sunlight: Low shade to medium indirect light
care.water: Water when top 2 inches dry out

careGuides.description: Drought tolerant; do not keep roots submerged in water.
Keep away from direct harsh rays which bleach dark foliage.

name: Red Prayer Plant
description: Velvety leaves striped with carmine red herringbone veins that fold up each evening in prayer.
highlights: Leaves fold together like hands in prayer at dusk
Vivid red veins provide striking table contrast

care.water: Keep consistently damp with filtered water
care.fertilizer: Diluted fertilizer every two weeks in summer

careGuides.description: Keep soil lightly moist. Avoid cold tap water.
Indirect light preserves the rich red veins.

name: Ponytail Palm
description: Swollen bulbous water-storing caudex topped with a whimsical fountain of curly ribbon fronds.
highlights: Stores weeks of water in its elephant-foot base

care.sunlight: Full sun to bright indirect light
care.water: Water thoroughly every 2-3 weeks; let dry

careGuides.description: Allow soil to dry out almost completely before watering again.
Happy on sunny windowsills or bright floor areas.

name: Zebra Haworthia
description: Compact architectural rosette studded with raised white horizontal zebra ridges.
highlights: Ideal size for home office workstations

care.sunlight: Bright indirect light or gentle morning sun
care.water: Water every 2-3 weeks when soil is dry
care.soil: Cactus soil with pumice or perlite
care.fertilizer: Once in spring at half strength

careGuides.description: Avoid standing water in rosette center. Water the soil perimeter.
Prefers bright indirect light over scorching midday rays.

name: Echeveria Elegans
description: Silvery powder-blue Mexican Snowball succulent with tight, symmetrical rose-like rosettes.
highlights: Covered in protective farina white wax coating
Pinkish tips develop in bright sunlight

care.water: Soak and dry method every 2 weeks
care.fertilizer: Diluted succulent fertilizer once in summer

careGuides.description: Water the soil directly, not the leaves, to preserve delicate powder coating.
Needs high light to avoid stretching.

name: Marble Queen Pothos
description: Heart-shaped leaves splashed with creamy white marble variegation that brightens living spaces.
highlights: High contrast creamy white and emerald splash

care.sunlight: Bright indirect light to maintain white marbling
care.water: Water when top 50% of soil feels dry

careGuides.description: Allow top half to dry out between waterings.
Keep in bright indirect light so variegation stays creamy white.

name: Neon Pothos
description: Electric chartreuse lime-green leaves that deliver an intense pop of modern color.
highlights: Glowing neon lime foliage stands out anywhere

care.sunlight: Bright indirect light for brightest chartreuse
care.water: Water every 7-10 days

careGuides.description: Water when top couple of inches are dry.
Bright indirect light maintains the radiant chartreuse tone.

name: Heartleaf Philodendron
description: Charming sweetheart-shaped deep green leaves that trail effortlessly over bookshelves and planters.
highlights: Easily propagated from single stem cuttings

care.water: Allow top half of soil to dry before watering

careGuides.description: Water once top inch or two dries out. Drooping leaves signal thirst.
Thrives in medium indirect light; also does well in shaded spots.

name: Philodendron Birkin
description: Stunning dark green glossy leaves adorned with crisp, creamy-white pinstriped variegation.
highlights: Each new leaf emerges with unique pinstripes

care.water: Water when top 2 inches dry out

careGuides.description: Water thoroughly, allowing excess to drain freely.
Bright indirect light ensures crisp pinstriping on new leaves.

name: Pink Princess Philodendron
description: Coveted black-burgundy leaves splashed with breathtaking sectors of bubblegum pink.
highlights: Dramatic contrast of dark foliage and bubblegum pink
Thrives with a moss climbing pole

care.sunlight: Bright indirect light (crucial for pink coloring)
care.water: Water when top 1-2 inches are dry
care.soil: Chunky orchid bark, perlite, and peat moss mix
care.fertilizer: Diluted fertilizer once a month in active season

careGuides.description: Water thoroughly and avoid soggy root conditions.
Bright filtered sunlight is essential to stimulate pink variegation.

name: Aglaonema Silver Bay
description: Silvery-centered broad leaves framed in deep forest green that flourish in dark rooms.
highlights: Removes benzene, formaldehyde, and other indoor toxins
Broad silver shields reflect ambient lighting

care.water: Allow top 50% of soil to dry between waterings
care.soil: Standard indoor potting mix with good drainage
care.fertilizer: Feed once in spring and once in summer

careGuides.description: Very forgiving; water every 10-14 days depending on light levels.
Thrives in dark corners where other plants struggle.

name: Aglaonema Red Siam
description: Lush green leaves edged and veined with radiant ruby red and hot pink highlights.
highlights: Brings vivid pink-red warmth to indoor decor

care.water: Water when top 2 inches dry out

careGuides.description: Water when topsoil feels dry. Avoid letting sit in cold saucer water.
Medium to bright indirect light keeps ruby margins vibrant.

name: Croton Petra
description: Explosive leathery foliage decorated with intense sunset bands of fiery red, orange, and yellow.
highlights: Provides rich autumnal color year round

care.sunlight: Bright direct morning sun to bright indirect
care.water: Keep consistently damp; water when top inch is dry

careGuides.description: Keep evenly moist. If leaves drop, check watering and light.
Full sunlight produces the richest reds and golds.

name: Parlor Palm
description: Beloved Victorian parlor palm with delicate, arching fan fronds that flourish in low light.
highlights: Popular since Victorian times for low light living rooms

care.water: Water when top 1-2 inches dry

careGuides.description: Allow surface to dry before giving another drink. Avoid soggy bottoms.
Thrives in subdued light; direct sun will bleach fronds.

name: Kentia Palm
description: The premier luxury architectural palm with graceful arching dark green fronds and high shade tolerance.
highlights: Favored in high-end hotels and residences

care.water: Water when top 2 inches dry out
care.fertilizer: Slow release palm fertilizer in spring

careGuides.description: Water thoroughly, discard excess water from tray. Let topsoil dry.
Adaptable from shady alcoves to bright rooms.

name: Dragon Tree
description: Slender curving woody trunks topped with crowns of sword-shaped leaves with thin red edges.

care.water: Water when top 50% of soil dries out
care.fertilizer: Light monthly feeding during warm months

careGuides.description: Allow top half of soil to dry before watering. Sensitive to fluoride.
Bright indirect light preserves the crimson margin.

name: Dracaena Corn Plant
description: Substantial wood cane trunks bearing lush rosettes of broad leaves with golden yellow central stripes.

care.water: Allow top 2-3 inches to dry between waterings

careGuides.description: Water thoroughly then let drain completely. Never leave in saucer pool.
Medium filtered light keeps golden central stripes sharp.

name: Maidenhair Fern
description: Ethereal cloud of lace-like fan leaflets on ebony wire stems that gently sway with any breeze.

care.water: Keep consistently damp; never let dry
care.soil: Moist peat moss and rich potting mix

careGuides.description: Soil must remain damp like a wrung-out sponge.
Mist daily or keep on a pebble humidity tray.

name: Bird's Nest Fern
description: Wavy apple-green crinkled fronds that unfurl from a central fuzzy rosette resembling a nest.
highlights: Simpler care than traditional feathery ferns

care.water: Water around edges when top inch dries; keep center dry
care.soil: Rich, aerated peat and bark mix

careGuides.description: Water the perimeter of soil. Never pour water into the central nest rosette.
Avoid direct sunlight which turns pale fronds yellow.

name: Staghorn Fern
description: Sculptural antler-shaped fronds that can be mounted directly on wooden wall boards as living art.
highlights: Can be displayed mounted on rustic wood plaques

care.water: Soak root ball in water bath once a week

careGuides.description: Submerge the mounted plaque or root ball in water for 10-15 minutes weekly.
Do not wipe off fuzzy white felt on fronds; it helps hold moisture.

name: Schefflera Umbrella Tree
description: Clusters of 7-9 glossy leaflets radiating from central stems like miniature emerald umbrellas.
highlights: Responds well to shaping and pruning

care.water: Water when top 2 inches dry out

careGuides.description: Allow soil to dry somewhat between waterings; avoid constantly soggy roots.
Pinch growing tips to encourage fuller, bushier branching.

name: Arabian Jasmine
description: Intensely fragrant star-shaped white flowers that release legendary sweet perfume at dusk.
highlights: Blooms repeatedly from spring through autumn
Fill rooms with natural intoxicating sweetness

care.sunlight: Full morning sun to bright indirect light
care.water: Keep evenly moist during flowering season
care.soil: Rich, moist organic soil with perlite
care.fertilizer: High potassium bloom food every 2 weeks

careGuides.description: Water consistently during flowering season. Do not let soil dry completely.
At least 4-6 hours of direct sun daily powers abundant blooms.

name: Tropical Hibiscus
description: Magnificent trumpet-shaped fiery blossoms with prominent long stamen columns.
highlights: Continuous bloom show throughout warm months

care.water: Water daily in hot summer weather
care.soil: Rich loamy soil with excellent drainage

careGuides.description: Very thirsty in sunny weather. Water thoroughly whenever topsoil dries.
Requires abundant direct sunlight to form buds.

name: Bougainvillea Royal Magenta
description: Riotous cascade of paper-thin magenta bracts that blanket trellises and sun-drenched balconies.
highlights: Electric magenta coverage all summer long
Flourishes in hot, sunny Mediterranean climates

care.water: Water thoroughly, then let dry almost completely

careGuides.description: Avoid overwatering. Slight water stress stimulates heavier flowering bracts.
Requires full direct sun to produce intense magenta color.

name: Mediterranean Olive Tree
description: Timeless Mediterranean beauty with silvery sage-green leaves, rustic trunk, and peaceful symbolism.
highlights: Ancient symbol of peace and longevity
Can be grown in pots on sunlit patios and lofts
Tolerant of wind, dry air, and missed waterings

care.water: Allow top 2-3 inches to dry between waterings

careGuides.description: Water deeply then let soil dry thoroughly. Do not overwater in winter.
Position in the sunniest window or patio location available.
